## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set on a typical image; flagged tier 2 [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100% | One dominant class |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 46th percentile | Typical, no flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Invasive | Neighbors agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Strongest concept-model association with invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 1, 5) · ↑ invasive · Also associated with invasive carcinoma [F4] · Validated
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 7, 9, 10) · context · Above 95% of reference images [F7] · Measured
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 3, 5) · ↑ invasive · Score high; failed AI spot check (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect classifier use; mitoses and necrosis are Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- Mitosis and necrosis scores failed spot checks (0/20, 3/20); they may overstate invasion.
- Cell measures reflect only regions 7, 9, 10, not the whole image.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 3:** confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma.
2. **Regions 0, 3, 5:** look for true mitoses; the model score failed its spot check.
3. **Region 8:** lowest invasive risk (86%); look for benign or in situ areas.
